{"status":"success","result":{"projects":[{"id":40703457,"title":"On-Site Machinery Photo Inspection","status":"active","seo_url":"photography/Site-Machinery-Photo-Inspection","currency":{"id":1,"code":"USD","sign":"$","name":"US Dollar","exchange_rate":1.0,"country":"US","is_external":false,"is_escrowcom_supported":true},"description":"I’ve just bought a piece of industrial machinery online and, before it ships, I want to see exactly what I’m paying for. I need someone in or near Santa Fe Springs who can visit the seller’s location and take a full set of high-resolution images that let me judge the machine’s true condition.

Please capture:

• Clear front and side views that show the machine in its entirety  
• Close, sharply focused shots of every visible serial or ID plate  
• Additional overview photos that give me a feel for the overall condition (paint wear, dents, leaks, rust, missing parts, etc.)

Natural light is fine if available, but bring a flash or portable LED so the serial numbers and hard-to-reach areas are readable. A phone is acceptable as long as it produces crisp, detailed images; a DSLR is even better.

Once you’ve finished, upload the original, uncompressed files to a shared drive or cloud link of your choice and label each image logically (e.g., “Front”, “Side”, “SerialPlate1”). No editing beyond basic exposure correction is necessary.

That’s all there is to it—
